title: Recover a local job lease safely
prompt: In the current Seloryn checkout, add or repair the bounded local job lifecycle case from the task fixture. Preflight must be read-only, leases must be atomic and expirable, stale ownership must not be accepted, and recovery must be event-authoritative. Do not invent a worker or remote execution system. Do not change VERSION.toml, publish, or use the network. Emit only the observable acceptance fields in the task-named adapter file.
limits: no worker, retry or remote execution
